Later core source contained source/diagnosticreport/structuredefinition-extension-diagnosticReport-risk.xml with DiagnosticReport and Observation contexts and Reference(RiskAssessment).

FHIR-53006 later clarified the same extension sentence in FHIR-extensions and retained the existing extension name and URL.
